question: In which year were the two most common causes of traffic accidents different from those in other years?
sql:
WITH yearly_counts AS (
  SELECT c.db_year, pcf.pcf_violation_category, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM collisions pcf
  JOIN case_ids c ON pcf.case_id = c.case_id
  WHERE pcf.pcf_violation_category IS NOT NULL AND pcf.pcf_violation_category != ''
  GROUP BY c.db_year, pcf.pcf_violation_category
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT db_year, pcf_violation_category, cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY db_year ORDER BY cnt DESC) as rn
  FROM yearly_counts
)
SELECT db_year, pcf_violation_category, cnt, rn
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY db_year, rn
